MEET THE ARTIST / 유라

youra

In “MIMI”, an absent name becomes someone to call for. Hear youra’s ONSTAGE performance alongside “Flicker” and “Motif”, three songs from different points in her work.

BY INDIEK / PUBLISHED 2026-10-27

Listen ↓Inside the lyrics ↓

youra’s first EP, B side, arrived in 2019. GAUSSIAN followed in 2021, and her first full-length album in 2023. In an interview with Allure Korea, she described her lyrics as personal diary writing and credited her collaboration with Mandong with giving her confidence.

R&B / SOUL / 2021

MIMI미미

Live performance

Release details ↗

“MIMI” calls to someone who has disappeared. youra wrote the lyrics and composed the song with Cosmic Boy for GAUSSIAN. The recording here is the ONSTAGE × D Museum live performance.

Lyrics by youra; music by youra and Cosmic Boy; original recording arranged by Cosmic Boy, with guitar by Kim Chunchu.

INSIDE THE LYRICS

Calling to someone absent

  • Absence
  • Longing

The refrain calls out to Mimi and asks why love disappears. A request for a friend to find the speaker gives the absence a second direction: someone missing also wants to be sought. The lyric leaves Mimi’s identity open.

MIMI: lyrics and credits on Bugs (Korean) ↗

R&B / SOUL / 2019

Flicker (feat. Car, the garden)깜빡

Live performance

Release details ↗

Written and composed by youra, “Flicker” appeared on her first EP, B side. Car, the garden arranged and featured on the original recording after hearing her demo. This version is an ONSTAGE live performance.

Lyrics and music by youra; original recording arranged by Car, the garden.

INSIDE THE LYRICS

Closeness and hesitation

  • Intimacy
  • Uncertainty

An embrace under a flickering streetlight leads into uncertainty about whether the connection is imagined. The speaker’s wish to hide leaves that uncertainty unresolved.

R&B / SOUL / 2023

Motif구운듯한 얼굴이 너의 모티프

Official audio

Release details ↗

“Motif” places a sinking sandcastle beside a garden where eternity was promised. It opens youra’s first full-length album and was composed with Mandong bassist Song Namhyun. This is the artist’s official audio.

Lyrics by youra; music by youra and Song Namhyun; arranged by Song Namhyun. Best R&B & Soul Song, Korean Music Awards 2024.

Official audio · 02:52

INSIDE THE LYRICS

Something fragile beside a promise

  • Fragility
  • Uncertainty

A sinking sandcastle and a garden associated with eternity put fragility beside a promise of permanence. The recurring invitation to walk farther keeps the song moving while leaving the relationship between those images open.
